messages.content: Translate every English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Stay faithful to the supplied text; add nothing from memory or other Bible versions. Use natural, grammatically correct Arabic. Return JSON only with book_code and verses[{chapter,verse,text_ar}]. Return exactly one item for each source unit in the same order with exact numeric references. No Latin letters. Expected refs: 2:5, 2:6, 2:7, 2:8, 2:9, 2:10, 2:11, 2:12, 2:13, 2:14

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"source_ref":"2:5","chapter":2,"verse":5,"text":"And every man made his god and they bowed down to them, and the sons of men forsook the Lord all the days of Enosh and his children; and the anger of the Lord was kindled on account of their works and abominations which they did in the earth."},{"source_ref":"2:6","chapter":2,"verse":6,"text":"And the Lord caused the waters of the river Gihon to overwhelm them, and he destroyed and consumed them, and he destroyed the third part of the earth, and notwithstanding this, the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were yet extended to do evil in the sight of the Lord."},{"source_ref":"2:7","chapter":2,"verse":7,"text":"And in those days there was neither sowing nor reaping in the earth; and there was no food for the sons of men and the famine was very great in those days."},{"source_ref":"2:8","chapter":2,"verse":8,"text":"And the seed which they sowed in those days in the ground became thorns, thistles and briers; for from the days of Adam was this declaration concerning the earth, of the curse of God, which he cursed the earth, on account of the sin which Adam sinned before the Lord."},{"source_ref":"2:9","chapter":2,"verse":9,"text":"And it was when men continued to rebel and transgress against God, and to corrupt their ways, that the earth also became corrupt."},{"source_ref":"2:10","chapter":2,"verse":10,"text":"And Enosh lived ninety years and he begat Cainan;"},{"source_ref":"2:11","chapter":2,"verse":11,"text":"And Cainan grew up and he was forty years old, and he became wise and had knowledge and skill in all wisdom, and he reigned over all the sons of men, and he led the sons of men to wisdom and knowledge; for Cainan was a very wise man and had understanding in all wisdom, and with his wisdom he ruled over spirits and demons;"},{"source_ref":"2:12","chapter":2,"verse":12,"text":"And Cainan knew by his wisdom that God would destroy the sons of men for having sinned upon earth, and that the Lord would in the latter days bring upon them the waters of the flood."},{"source_ref":"2:13","chapter":2,"verse":13,"text":"And in those days Cainan wrote upon tablets of stone, what was to take place in time to come, and he put them in his treasures."},{"source_ref":"2:14","chapter":2,"verse":14,"text":"And Cainan reigned over the whole earth, and he turned some of the sons of men to the service of God."}]}
